## Installation

### GitHub
Install the development version from GitHub

```r
# install.packages("devtools")
install.packages(c("susieR", "colocboost"))   # CRAN releases
devtools::install_github("xueweic/transmap")
```

`remotes::install_github("xueweic/transmap")` works the same way.

### From source
Clone the repository and install it from the package root

```bash
git clone https://github.com/xueweic/transmap.git
R CMD INSTALL transmap
```

## Dependencies

`transmap` requires R (>= 4.0.0). The following CRAN packages are installed
automatically with `transmap`:

- `susieR`, for fine-mapping program phenotypes;
- `colocboost`, for multi-phenotype colocalization;
- `PMA` (penalized matrix decomposition), `RANN` (nearest neighbour search),
  `MASS` and `Matrix`.

`susieR` and `colocboost` are installed from CRAN. If a development version of
either package was previously installed from GitHub, `install_github()` may
update it from GitHub instead; running `install.packages(c("susieR",
"colocboost"))` first, as above, replaces it with the CRAN release.

The Bioconductor package `AUCell` is optional. It is needed only for
`transmap_local(method = "AUCell")`:

```r
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}
BiocManager::install("AUCell")
```

## Check the installation

```{r}
library(transmap)
data(transmap_example)
names(transmap_example)
```
